start.explanation: We need to understand your current voting status to provide the correct guidance.
start.simple: Tell us who you are so we can help.
start.why: Different voter types have different requirements and deadlines.
start.action: Select the option that best describes you.

alert.message: Your selection will customize the next steps.

start.recommendation: Take a moment to confirm your current voter registration status before proceeding.

registration_check.explanation: We need to know if you have already submitted a voter registration application.
registration_check.simple: Have you already applied to register?
registration_check.why: This determines whether you need to start a new application or just track an existing one.
registration_check.action: Indicate whether you have started the registration process.

alert.message: If you are unsure, it is best to assume you have not started.

registration_check.recommendation: Check with your local electoral office if you are unsure about your registration status.

verify_registration.explanation: You should check if your name is already on the official electoral roll.
verify_registration.simple: Look up your name on the voter list.
verify_registration.why: This prevents duplicate registrations and confirms your eligibility to vote.
verify_registration.action: Check your status online using your voter ID.

alert.message: Make sure your details match your ID exactly.

verify_registration.recommendation: Visit the National Voter Service Portal to verify your registration instantly.

candidate_intro.explanation: Political candidates have a separate set of strict guidelines and nomination procedures.
candidate_intro.why: Filing for candidacy requires specific legal compliance.

alert.message: Do not miss the nomination deadline.

candidate_intro.recommendation: Use the Suvidha Portal for online nomination filing and affidavit submission.

eligibility_info.explanation: You must meet the basic age and citizenship requirements to register.
eligibility_info.simple: You need to be 18+ and a citizen.
eligibility_info.why: Only eligible citizens are legally allowed to participate in the election.
eligibility_info.action: Review the eligibility criteria before proceeding.
eligibility_info.recommendation: Confirm your age using your birth certificate or Aadhaar card before collecting documents.

document_collection.explanation: You need specific official documents to prove your identity and address.
document_collection.simple: Get your ID proof, address proof, and photo ready.
document_collection.why: Electoral rules require strict verification to prevent voter fraud.
document_collection.action: Gather your Identity Proof, Address Proof, and a Passport Photograph.

alert.message: Ensure all documents are valid and not expired.

document_collection.recommendation: Use Aadhaar, Passport, or Driving License as identity proof for faster processing.

application_submission.explanation: You must formally submit your voter registration form (Form 6).
application_submission.simple: Submit Form 6 online or at the office.
application_submission.why: Submission is required to be added to the official electoral roll.
application_submission.action: Submit the form online or visit your local electoral office.

alert.message: Urgent: Complete this before the application deadline.

application_submission.recommendation: Online submission via the NVSP portal is the fastest method.

done.explanation: You have completed the guided steps for your voter profile.
done.why: Your action items are complete for this phase.
done.action: Wait for further notifications or check your status online.
done.recommendation: Bookmark the NVSP portal to track your voter ID card delivery.
